interpretation: No selective pain removal in these fixed tasks; positive average dose interaction is strongly position-dependent and does not satisfy the full titration rule.
limits: R1 supports contain 1–21 initial scenarios per condition/position, selected by first-choice behavior.
R1 pain/sadness first-position support has one scenario; its zero-width interval is not evidence of precision.
R1 pain/fear first-position support has four scenarios, all with the same difference; its zero-width interval is likewise not strong precision evidence.
R1 intervals omit draws with no matched support: finite replicate counts are retained in every table.
The random/random practical-null comparison remains inconclusive and changes sign across positions.
Initial-scenario bootstrap is conditional on the fixed corpus; adjacent trials share later concatenated source text.
Intervals are pointwise, not simultaneous; no subjective experience, learning or generalized incapacity is established.
